name: vidmuse
description: VidMuse motion-film and media plugin for Codex. /vidmuse is the mandatory intent router: existing speaking-footage films go to /vidmuse-recut; films whose material must be made go to /vidmuse-create; semantic asset/library work goes to /vidmuse-assets; standalone ASR, ATA, TTS, generation, and deterministic media operations go directly to /media-use. Film workflows retain deliverable ownership while capability skills execute one layer.

interface.shortDescription: Route · Recut · Create · ASR/TTS · Asset intelligence
interface.longDescription: Use /vidmuse as the mandatory front door. It routes existing speaking-footage films to /vidmuse-recut, films whose material must be made to /vidmuse-create, semantic asset/library work to /vidmuse-assets, and standalone transcription/ASR, ATA, TTS/voiceover, generation, trim/reframe/transform, and grading directly to /media-use. Film workflows retain deliverable ownership while capability domains execute exact layers. User film preview uses vidmuse serve multi-track DSL.
